one_line: Early Nediyiruppu Zamorin, Samanthan Nair warlord who seized Malabar coast access and Mamankam prestige after the Perumal era.

appearance.age_look: late 30s, athletic and wiry, with the poised bearing of a seasoned commander
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Malabar complexion, sharp nose, high cheekbones, neatly trimmed moustache, intense almond-shaped eyes, and a calm, calculating default expression that hints at strategic focus rather than overt aggression
appearance.hair: thick black hair oiled and combed back into a low, neat knot at the nape, front kept smooth with a slight middle part, topped by a simple off-white Kerala-style headcloth folded into a narrow band and tied at the back like a modest turban
appearance.costume: He wears a traditional Kerala double-draped costume: an off-white cotton mundu with a narrow maroon border wrapped firmly from waist to ankles, a second shorter off-white cloth with broader maroon and gold borders tied around the hips like a war-ready kachcha for ease of movement, and an upper cotton cloth in deep maroon draped over the left shoulder and around the torso, leaving both shoulders covered and chest modestly wrapped; the textiles are plain but finely woven, with subtle gold thread edging on the borders to show status; his arms bear simple gold bangles, and he has a thin gold chain around his neck and small gold stud earrings, along with a vertical sandalwood paste tilak and red kumkum dot on his forehead marking ritual prestige rather than royal coronation; he is barefoot, wearing only simple leather sandals suitable for coastal terrain.
appearance.signature: A long Malabar urumi, the flexible sword associated with Nair warriors, coiled at his waist in a plain brown leather scabbard and held partly uncoiled in his right hand, its steel gleaming and the hilt wrapped in dark red cloth for grip.

ref_desc: Manavikrama Zamorin is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed man in off-white Kerala drapery with maroon and gold borders, black hair in a low knot under a narrow headcloth, simple gold ornaments, leather sandals, and a gleaming urumi sword with dark red-wrapped hilt.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Manavikrama Zamorin of Calicut: a late-30s, athletic Malabar Samanthan Nair warlord with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp nose, high cheekbones, intense almond eyes, and a calm strategic expression. His black hair is oiled and combed back into a low knot at the nape, with a slight middle part, covered by a simple off-white Kerala headcloth folded into a narrow band and tied at the back. He wears an era-accurate Kerala outfit: an off-white cotton mundu with a narrow maroon border wrapped from waist to ankles, a second shorter off-white cloth with broader maroon and gold borders tied over it around the hips like a practical war-ready kachcha, and a deep maroon upper cloth draped over the left shoulder and around his torso, keeping his chest and shoulders modestly covered. Add subtle gold edging on the borders to show status, small gold stud earrings, a thin gold chain, and simple gold bangles on his arms, along with a vertical sandalwood tilak and red kumkum dot on his forehead. Put simple leather sandals on his feet. His signature weapon is a long Malabar urumi: show part of the flexible steel blade coiled at his waist in a plain brown leather scabbard, with one loop held in his right hand, its hilt wrapped in dark red cloth. Use a palette dominated by off-white, maroon, gold, deep brown, and steel gray, and present him in neutral, front and slight-angle views so the face, hair, costume, and urumi are all clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
